title: Janus Advisor Inc. - Funeral Home Network
description: Enterprise-scale digital modernization for a leading equity firm managing multiple funeral home properties.
body:
Serving as the IT lead for Janus Advisor Inc., I am executing a massive digital overhaul for their network of funeral home properties. This initiative involves migrating a fleet of over 20 legacy sites from restrictive, high-premium Squarespace plans to a custom, high-performance React + Vite framework. This transition not only provides a significantly more premium aesthetic but also delivers substantial operational efficiency, saving the firm between $240 and $1,200 annually per property in hosting fees alone.

A critical technical objective was achieving granular control over the UI that out-of-the-box templates couldn't provide. A prime example is the 'Available 24/7' Call Now button integrated directly into the site headers—a high-converting feature essential for the industry that Squarespace's rigid template system could not accommodate. Current successful migrations include Cremation Simplicity, with Blair's Cremation, McNary's Woodland, and Chapel by the Sea currently under review for final deployment.

before.title: Rigid SaaS (Squarespace)
before.description: High hosting premiums ($20-$100/mo per site) and restrictive templates that blocked essential UI features like enhanced header CTAs.

after.title: Custom Enterprise Edge
after.description: Zero-cost Cloudflare hosting with a 20+ site roadmap, featuring custom 'Available 24/7' CTAs and a premium, bespoke aesthetic.

title: Amazing Grace Media
description: A high-performance videographer portfolio replacing a bloated Wix site.
body:
A videographer's work demands a platform as sharp as their lens. This project involved migrating a media-heavy portfolio from Wix to a custom React + Vite architecture. By stripping away the computational bloat and pervasive script errors inherent in the original platform, I achieved near-instantaneous load times and a fluid scrolling experience that lets the cinematography take center stage.

The transition to Cloudflare Pages ensured global edge delivery, providing a rock-solid, high-bandwidth experience for potential clients regardless of their location.

before.title: Legacy Wix Build
before.description: Littered with HTML/JS errors and sluggish performance. Computational bloat obscured the high-quality media content.

after.title: Artisan React Site
after.description: Blazing fast, error-free delivery with a fresh design optimized for high-definition video presentation.

title: Red Bluff Church of Christ
description: A comprehensive digital transformation featuring a custom-built member portal and CMS.
body:
Moving beyond a brittle HostGator setup, I engineered a robust digital ecosystem for this community. The highlight is a custom-built CMS that empowers leadership with full CRUD operations for announcements, Bible studies, and weekly devotionals. The Bible study module includes a sophisticated text editor and live preview tool, while the Devotional section features an elegant text-over-image experience.

To protect sensitive community information, I implemented a multi-tiered user hierarchy (Registered, Member, Admin, Owner) with an approval-based onboarding flow. Announcements can be flagged for 'Member Only' visibility, ensuring privacy for the congregation while maintaining a public-facing ministry.

before.title: Brittle Legacy Hosting
before.description: Unbearable maintenance on HostGator; updates frequently broke functionality, and manual rollbacks were common.

after.title: Empowered Community Portal
after.description: A secure, multi-role backend with custom editing tools, achieving faster load times and zero maintenance friction.

title: CorbinMeier.net
description: The portfolio you are currently viewing, built with a focus on speed and security.
body:
This site represents my personal standard for web architecture. I migrated from a heavy Next.js + Vercel + Supabase stack to a streamlined React + Vite implementation on Cloudflare Pages. This shift eliminated unnecessary runtime overhead and consolidated the infrastructure into a zero-cost, high-performance static delivery model.

By leveraging TypeScript for structural integrity and Cloudflare's edge network for security, I've created a platform that is not only fast but virtually impenetrable and infinitely scalable.

before.title: Next.js / Supabase Stack
before.description: Heavier framework dependencies and reliance on external database services for relatively static data.

after.title: Streamlined Static Edge
after.description: Minimal runtime, maximum security, and high performance with zero-cost infrastructure.

title: Chuck the Painter
description: A professional portfolio and SEO-focused site that reached over 1,500 unique visitors in its first month.
body:
Digital confidence is the cornerstone of local business growth. For this project, I transformed a word-of-mouth operation into a searchable digital powerhouse. The new site focuses on high-visibility project showcases and aggressive SEO optimization.

In its first month of operation, the site successfully handled over 16,000 requests from 1,500 unique visitors, with a 40% cache hit rate. By implementing clean, bot-friendly markup and structured data, the site is now actively crawled, steadily climbing the ranks to connect Chuck with new potential clients.

before.title: No Digital Presence
before.description: Relying entirely on word-of-mouth with no central portfolio for prospective clients to verify quality.

after.title: Search-Optimized Hub
after.description: 1,500+ monthly unique visitors and 40% cached traffic, building immediate trust through a professional gallery.

title: Atlas Energy Consulting
description: A high-performance recreation of a WordPress site to lower costs and improve design.
body:
WordPress often imposes rigid design constraints and high operational costs. For Atlas Energy, I provided a complete architectural escape, recreating their entire digital presence in a custom React framework. This move eliminated the need for expensive managed hosting and the constant headache of plugin security updates.

The result is a pixel-perfect, lightning-fast site that gives the client full design freedom while slashing their monthly overhead to a fraction of the previous cost.

before.title: Rigid WordPress Build
before.description: Hard limits on layout and high hosting fees. Constant maintenance overhead for plugin security.

after.title: Custom Edge Framework
after.description: Infinite design flexibility, superior performance, and significantly reduced operational expenses.

title: Johnsons Turboclean
description: Professionalizing a DIY effort into a cohesive, high-performance brand portal.
body:
A potential client reached out to bridge the gap between their manual DIY efforts and a professional digital presence. This project focuses on building a cohesive brand identity from the ground up, paired with a modern web experience that reflects the precision of their services.

The new architecture moves away from consumer-grade builders to a custom professional stack, ensuring that as the business scales, the website remains a robust and reliable asset.

before.title: DIY Builder Effort
before.description: The client struggled with the limitations of DIY tools, resulting in a site that lacked professional polish.

after.title: Professional Brand Hub
after.description: A unified identity and high-performance site that allows the business to scale with authority.

title: Envee Hair Studio
description: A high-fidelity site migration completed in a single day after a previous developer failed to deliver.
body:
This project was a critical rescue mission. Nichole already had a functioning site, but a third-party developer offered to recreate it with the promise of modernization. After months of waiting with no progress to show, the third party eventually dropped the ball, leaving Nichole to revert to her original, outdated setup in frustration.

Leveraging my streamlined React + Vite framework, I was able to step in and deliver a high-fidelity modernization—a complete recreation of the desired design—in just a single day of work. The focus was on capturing the boutique's aesthetic while implementing modern performance optimizations, proving that high-quality delivery doesn't require months of development time.

before.title: Failed Recreation Attempt
before.description: A third party promised a new site but failed to deliver after months, forcing the client back to her original legacy setup.

after.title: 24-Hour Modernization
after.description: A complete, high-fidelity recreation delivered in a single day, providing the professional digital home the salon deserved.

title: Vehicles Management
description: Tracks vehicle essential information, documents, and live/recorded locations. On-premise deployment for internal fleet management.
body:
This on-premise fleet management system centralizes vehicle information, including registration, service history, documentation, and location logs. Designed for businesses that require internal hosting and strict data controls.

  • Document uploads and versioning
  • Location logging (live & recorded)
  • Role-based access and audit logs

title: Employees HR Portal
description: Human Resources system that digitizes and stores employee records, documents, and history. Built for secure on-premise hosting.
body:
An HR portal that digitizes personnel records, stores signed documents, and tracks employment history. Emphasis on privacy and on-premise deployment for organizations with internal-only data policies.

Features include secure document storage, custom reporting, and role-based workflows for approvals.

title: Buildings & Sites Manager
description: Real-estate and site management system tracking building files, time-sensitive reminders, and location-specific metadata.
body: A property and site management tool for maintaining building records, lease documents, and maintenance schedules. Includes reminder notifications for inspections and lease renewals.

title: Night&Day (Mobile App)
description: A mobile app currently in development for both Android and iOS. Work in progress.
body: Night&Day is a cross-platform Flutter app designed for seamless experiences on iOS and Android. Current work includes authentication, local state syncing, and responsive UI tuned for mobile interactions.

title: Inventory & Asset System
description: College inventory system using a GraphQL API and MySQL with WebSocket-based live updates for real-time inventory and asset tracking.
body:
Built as a college project, this inventory and asset management app uses a GraphQL backend and WebSocket-powered live updates for changes to inventory counts, checkouts, and reservations.

It demonstrates real-time collaboration patterns and efficient querying with GraphQL.

title: Gestational Diabetes Tracking Assistant
description: A Flutter app for quick number tracking, CSV exporting, and filtered data views to assist gestational diabetes monitoring (college project).
body: This tool helps users log blood glucose readings quickly, export sessions as CSV for sharing with clinicians, and filter/view trends over time. Built with usability and quick data entry in mind.

title: Media Control API
description: Python-based API for programmatic media control and device management, built as a college project.
body: A lightweight Python API that exposes programmatic controls for media playback and device discovery on local networks. Useful as a centralized control layer for automation scripts and integrations.

title: Windows Toast LAN Messenger
description: Windows Toast and notification system enabling LAN messaging between devices for quick local notifications.
body: A small utility that sends Windows toast notifications across a LAN. Designed for quick local messaging without a centralized server—great for internal team alerts or small office broadcasts.

title: Public College Courses Projects
description: The work from my CSCI 031 college course, including web apps and tools built with modern technologies.
body: Aggregated course work showcasing web apps, tooling, and experiments. Includes examples using modern stacks like Next.js, Supabase, Prisma, and Turborepo monorepos.
